title: Intolerable
summary: INTOL'ERABLE, adjective [Latin intolerabilis; in and tolerabilis, tolero, to bear.] 1. Not to be borne; that cannot be endured; as intolerable pain; intolerable heat or cold; an intolerable burden. 2.

inlines.v: INTOL'ERABLE, adjective [Latin intolerabilis; in and tolerabilis, tolero, to bear.] 1. Not to be borne; that cannot be endured; as intolerable pain; intolerable heat or cold; an intolerable burden. 2. Insufferable; as intolerable laziness.
